tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App background. The warm cream (light) or deep night (dark) everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the chat list, incoming bubbles on surface-0 in light mode.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or pressed: input fields, hover rows, secondary buttons, incoming bubbles in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Previews, metadata, secondary labels. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps and hints on surface-0/surface-1. Not for anything load-bearing.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The ghost's body and primary buttons. Inverts between themes so the ghost is always the high-contrast shape.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text, icons and ghost eyes placed on brand.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember. The ghost's cheeks, the send button, unread badges, the one hot spot per screen. Fill only, never text on light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (7:1). Never white on ember.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted highlight: mention chips, selected rows, reaction pills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Ember when it has to be text or a link on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: bubble-out
tokens.usage: Your own messages. Ink in light, ember in dark.

tokens.name: on-bubble-out
tokens.usage: Text, ticks and timestamps inside bubble-out.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: Other people's messages.

tokens.name: on-bubble-in
tokens.usage: Text inside bubble-in.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Presence dot and success states. Pair with a label or shape, not colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, failed-to-send.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Connection issues, pending states.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Screen titles on mobile, sheet titles, the chat header name.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Chat list names, section headings, dialog headings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tick spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked bubbles from the same sender.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bubble horizontal padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on mobile, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between message groups, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The tail corner of a bubble (the corner nearest the sender).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Message bubbles, cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, app-icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, composer, avatars, badges.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and the composer resting above content.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, dialogs.
